documented_fact: Planned topics: North American marriage rites; flood myths across Asia/Africa/Europe.
implication: Shows prospectus/programme layer should be separated from retrospective annual report and from actual participant records.

course_or_actor: Marillier / Religions des peuples non civilisés
documented_fact: Actual report describes North American family/marriage plus flood myths and comparative inference.
implication: Annual report is a retrospective content witness, not merely a schedule.

course_or_actor: Finot substituting Foucher / Religions de l'Inde
documented_fact: Finot taught Vedānta exegesis; Mauss is named as an élève titulaire; Lacôte as active auditor.
implication: Directly fixes Mauss inside the Indian-religions seminar ecology immediately before his remembered Pāli/Buddhist-translation training.

course_or_actor: Israël Lévi / Judaïsme talmudique et rabbinique
documented_fact: Second semester studied the fate of the soul after death and emphasized variety of beliefs; Mauss is named among élèves titulaires.
implication: A named Mauss control shows afterlife comparison and Indianist training coexisted in one student's EPHE formation before Lovejoy's Marillier year.

course_or_actor: Marillier / Religions des peuples non civilisés
documented_fact: Planned human sacrifice and ritual anthropophagy on Wednesdays 9:30; American marriage on Fridays 9:30.
implication: The sacrifice/anthropophagy line begins at least one academic year before Lovejoy's documented participation.

course_or_actor: Marillier / Religions des peuples non civilisés
documented_fact: Actual Wednesday conference studied ritual anthropophagy and human sacrifice, including funerary, expiatory, anthropophagic and magical sacrifices in West/African regions.

course_or_actor: Marillier / Religions des peuples non civilisés
documented_fact: Planned: beliefs concerning survival of the soul, Wednesdays 5; ritual anthropophagy and human sacrifice, Fridays 9:30.
implication: These are exactly the two dominant thematic blocks in Lovejoy notebook 005.

course_or_actor: Marillier / Religions des peuples non civilisés
documented_fact: Retrospective report: survivance/eschatology conference plus continued human-sacrifice/ritual-anthropophagy research; Lovejoy explicitly named among auditors who took an active part in the work.
implication: Strongest primary institutional bridge from 005's themes to Lovejoy's active Paris participation.

documented_fact: Programme advertises Wednesday/Friday; annual report labels the two conferences Monday/Tuesday. Exact reason not yet established.
implication: Do not reconstruct Lovejoy's weekly timetable from the advance programme alone; actual scheduling may have changed.

documented_fact: Rules state candidates/auditors chose conferences; those admitted had to register on the register before each lesson; prolonged absence had to be justified; school year ran 1 Nov-15 Jul.
implication: A lesson-level attendance/sign-in documentary layer existed in principle. If preserved/digitized, it could tighten Lovejoy's arrival and attendance chronology beyond annual-report status. Do not assume current AN 'registres d'inscription' are automatically this same register.

documented_fact: Programme states conferences for 1898-99 begin 3 November at the Nouvelle-Sorbonne, 46 rue Saint-Jacques.
implication: Gives a hard institutional opening-date control for IVe Section teaching; not automatically the first date Lovejoy personally attended.

documented_fact: After mission interruption in 1897-98, next report documents Bhagavad-Gītā and continuous Indian-literature teaching; Stickney actively participated.
implication: Confirms actual instruction layer differs from generic chair title and supports the no-formal-Pāli-course result.

course_or_actor: Sylvain Lévi / Louis Finot / Marcel Mauss
documented_fact: Mauss later recalled first-stage Sanskrit discipline, then Pāli and Buddhist translation with Lévi and Finot; he also said Lévi's 1896-97 Brāhmaṇa course was personally directed to him.
implication: Shows formal programme and individualized instruction are not equivalent documentary layers; important control for Wilson's report of Lovejoy's private readings with Lévi.

documented_fact: Much later EPHE report explicitly records Lévi convening former auditors at his home when fixed-hour conferences were disrupted.
implication: Demonstrates home-based scholarly instruction was a documented practice in Lévi's teaching repertoire, but does not prove the same modality in 1898 without Lovejoy's letters.
